title: 金苹果服务器GoldenApple Server
description: 由GoldenApple-Studio管理的开放玩法服务器。An open-play server managed by GoldenApple-Studio.
body:
- **欢迎来到这片自由的土地
这是一个纯原版玩法的Java版生存服务器，没有任何模组和魔改，保留Minecraft最本真的乐趣
你可以在这里自由探索无限世界 建造宏伟的建筑 研究复杂的红石机械 或者只是享受日出日落的宁静
服务器完全开放 没有领地限制 没有繁琐规则 你的每一个方块都由双手创造 每一次冒险都真实可感
我们拥有稳定的服务器性能和友好的玩家社区 无论是独狼玩家还是团队协作 都能找到属于自己的生存节奏
加入我们 从第一棵橡树开始 书写你的生存故事
期待与你在这片方块世界中相遇**
- **Welcome to this land of freedom
This is a pure vanilla Java Edition survival server with no mods or alterations, preserving the most authentic fun of Minecraft
Here you can freely explore an infinite world, build magnificent structures, tinker with complex redstone contraptions, or simply enjoy the tranquility of sunrises and sunsets
The server is completely open with no land claims and no tedious rules. Every block is crafted by your own hands, every adventure feels truly real
We offer stable server performance and a friendly player community. Whether you are a lone wolf or a team player, you will find your own survival rhythm here
Join us, start from your first oak tree, and write your own survival story
We look forward to meeting you in this world of blocks**
